name: Telf Joolam
summary: At the Shrine of the Dormant Flame, Telf Joolam guides Horde initiates in the ways of fire. The Darkspear shaman teaches them to commune with and command this volatile element.

sections.title: Keeper of the Flame
sections.body: Among the crags above the borderlands, Telf Joolam tends the Shrine of the Dormant Flame. Fire spirits call for sharp discipline and a steady mind. Earth offers calm certainty, and water asks for patience. Telf prepares young shamans for trials where wild embers can consume the unready.

sections.title: The Path of Fire
sections.body: Under Telf's guidance, initiates brew and drink a ritual Fire Sapta. It opens their mortal eyes to the unseen elemental planes. Then he sends them up the rocky summits to face burning spirits. Those who earn the flame must honor its ravenous hunger and master their pride.

faq.answer: Telf Joolam, a Darkspear troll shaman, tends the Shrine of the Dormant Flame. He guides young shamans who seek communion with fire.

faq.q: Where can Telf Joolam be found?
faq.answer: Telf Joolam can be found at the Shrine of the Dormant Flame, high on the rocky ridge between Durotar and the Barrens.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Fire Sapta he asks for?
faq.answer: The Fire Sapta opens an initiate's spiritual vision, so they can perceive and speak with elemental fire spirits unseen by mortal eyes.

faq.q: What element does Telf Joolam teach?
faq.answer: Telf Joolam teaches fire. He tests shamans' strength and will, so they can control flame without yielding to its destructive nature.

faq.q: Why is a troll overseeing shamanic rites here?
faq.answer: Since joining Thrall's Horde, many Darkspear trolls have taken up shamanism alongside orcs and tauren. Experienced shamans such as Telf guide the next generation.

faq.q: What happens after completing Telf Joolam's tasks?
faq.answer: After proving mastery over the flame spirits on the nearby peak, initiates gain the knowledge and blessing to forge their permanent Fire Totem.

angles.text: As a shaman, you follow Telf Joolam's guidance through the Fire Sapta trials and learn to master your Fire Totem.
As a troll, you see a Darkspear elder guiding initiates in shamanic ways shared across the Horde.
As a member of the Horde, you see elders like Telf guard sacred elemental shrines throughout the borderlands and strengthen the Horde's spiritual roots.
